caption: Deterministic role matching uses curated technology taxonomies and whole word matching. JobRez relies on a deterministic model for matching your resume branches to live job postings. Each master resume branch is scored against the posting in Job DNA, which uses a curated technology taxonomy with aliases and whole-word matching. Required terms carry double weight while preferred terms count once. This process involves no cloud AI and no external verification. Learn more at https://jobrez.com.
altText: Slide 1, 2, and 3 showing deterministic matching logic, taxonomy, and weighted scoring.
